decision.completeness_basis: Majors list on the 'University Catalog 2026-2027' Undergraduate page (stored only in the discovery run). Its 273 entries, mostly 'Major (BS): X Concentration', collapse to 101 major+award programs, the same count as the reviewed record. The two spellings of Parks, Recreation(,) and Tourism Management (BS) count as one major. Excluded: AAS entries and first-year, exploratory and transfer entries. Counted though unsure: the 2 Mathematics Education double majors, and Biological Engineering (BS) separately from Biological, Agricultural, and Ecological Engineering (BS). All 97 verified records are list pages and cover 70 of the 101. 61 majors are matched on the bare-major page. 9 are matched through concentration records because the list has no bare-major page for them: Agricultural Education, Agroecology & Sustainable Food Systems, Crop and Soil Sciences, Food Science, Horticultural Science, Leadership in the Public Sector (Distance Education page), Mathematics Education, Natural Resources and Science Education.
decision.reason: Catalog-count review 2026-10-07: official current list page.

decision.completeness_basis: Degrees and Certificates Offered page of the 2026-2027 Bulletin (fetched via https://about.wfu.edu/academics/degrees/, which redirects there; stored only in the discovery run). Each bachelor award is counted per row and award as records are keyed (e.g. Biology BA and BS = 2), with Decision Analytics BS (listed twice) counted once. Excluded: combined BS/MS, MS/BA and BS/BA+MA rows and graduate/professional awards. The 55 verified records cover 55 of the 59; missing are Decision Analytics BS, Education BA, and Interdisciplinary Major BA and BS.
